subject: Action: Provide current subprocessor snapshot + export route mapping (SkyBound security review)
messages:
From: Ethan Clarke <ethan.clarke@skybound.com>

Cc: procurement@skybound.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SkyBound security: request for current subprocessor roster + export routes

Hi Karthik,

We're starting the security review ahead of our renewal and need a current snapshot of Redwood's subprocessors that process/transit SkyBound data. Specifically we need:

- A CSV roster with name, country of processing, role (e.g., telemetry, cache, observability), whether they persist data, and encryption at rest keys (KMS/HSM) used.
- For any partner that routes traffic outside the EU/US, an export-route mapping (which subprocessor -> country -> egress destination).
- Confirmation whether any subcontractors have access to plaintext customer data or secrets (yes/no).
- Links to latest SOC 2 snapshot and any onshore fallback/escrow arrangements.

Timing: can you provide the roster + export map by EOD tomorrow (Wed 3 Mar) so our legal + procurement teams can start the DPA review? If you prefer a call, I can make time 11:00–14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Clarke | Security Lead, SkyBound
security@skybound.com

--
